### GLV Dynamics

### Stochastic Dynamics



$$
\frac{d}{dt} n_{i} = 
    r_{i}\left(1-\frac{n_{i}}{k_{i}} \right) n_{i}
    + \sum_{i \neq j}^{S} \epsilon_{i,j} n_{i} n_{j}
$$


$$
dn_{i} = \left[
    r_{i}\left(1-\frac{n_{i}}{k_{i}} \right) n_{i}
    + \sum_{i \neq j}^{S} \epsilon_{i,j} n_{i} n_{j}
\right] dt
$$


$$
dn_{i} = \left[
    \left(r_{i} -\frac{r_{i} n_{i}}{k_{i} } \right) n_{i}
    + \sum_{i \neq j}^{S} \epsilon_{i,j} n_{i} n_{j}
\right] dt
$$


$$
A_{ij} = 
\begin{cases}
- \frac{r_{i}}{k_{i}} & i = j \\
\epsilon_{ij} & i \neq j
\end{cases}
$$


then 

$$
dn_{i} = \left[
    \left(r_{i} -\frac{r_{i} n_{i}}{k_{i}} \right) n_{i}
    + \sum_{i \neq j}^{S} \epsilon_{i,j} n_{i} n_{j}
\right] dt
$$



$$
d n_i = n_i \left( r_i + \sum_{j} A_{ij} n_j \right) dt
 + \sigma n_i \sqrt{dt}
$$


For the stationary state we get 

$$
\mathbf{n}^{*} = - A^{-1} \mathbf{r} 
$$

To visualize the dynamics of the generalized lotka-volterra model under stochastic noise we shown in Fig.

```{python}
from matplotlib.ticker import FormatStrFormatter


def plot_matrix_A(A_np: np.array, species_ids: np.array, ax: plt.Axes) -> None:
    """Plot the interaction matrix."""
    n_i, n_j = A_np.shape
    max_abs_A = np.max(np.abs(A_np)) 
    im = ax.imshow(A_np, cmap="coolwarm", interpolation="none", origin='lower',
    vmin=-max_abs_A, vmax=max_abs_A, aspect='auto')
    # ax.set_title("Interaction matrix A")
    ax.set_xlabel("Species j")
    ax.set_ylabel("Species i")
    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, orientation="vertical", shrink=0.8)
    # Show colorbar tick labels with 2 significant digits
    cbar.formatter = FormatStrFormatter("%.2g")
    cbar.update_ticks()

    # # Draw grid lines to visually separate cells
    # ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-0.5, n_j, 1), minor=True)
    # ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-0.5, n_i, 1), minor=True)
    ax.set_xticks(species_ids)
    ax.set_yticks(species_ids)

    # ax.grid(which="minor", color="white", linestyle="-", linewidth=3)
    ax.tick_params(which="minor", bottom=False, left=False)

    # Overlay each matrix entry with 2-significant-digit text
    for i in range(n_i):
        for j in range(n_j):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{A_np[i, j]:.2g}", ha="center", va="center", color="black")



def plot_percentiles_time(traj_stoch, species_ids:np.array, qs, ax: plt.Axes) -> None:
    # qs = [5, 25, 50, 75, 95]
    traj_perc = np.percentile(traj_stoch, q=qs, axis=0)
    for idx in range(len(species_ids)):
    # for idx in range(1):
        for idper in range( len(qs)//2 ):
            ax.fill_between(time, traj_perc[idper, :, idx], traj_perc[len(qs)-1-idper, :, idx], color=traj_colors[idx], alpha=0.25 )
            # ax.fill_between(time, traj_perc[len(qs)//2 , :, idx], traj_perc[idper, :, idx], color=traj_colors[idx], alpha=0.25 )
        ax.plot(time, traj_perc[len(qs)//2, :, idx], color=traj_colors[idx])

        ax.plot(time, traj_det[0, :, idx], color=traj_colors[idx], linestyle='--', linewidth=3, label=f"{idx}")
        # ax.plot(time, traj_stoch[:, :, idx].mean(axis=0), color=traj_colors[idx], linewidth=3)

    ax.set(
        xlabel="Time",
        ylabel=r"Abundance $n_i$"
    )
    # ax.legend()

```




```{python}
#| label: fig-glv4stoch
#| fig-cap: a) Growth rate of species $i$, b) interaction matrix $A$, c) noise intensity, d) time evolution of deterministic trajectory (dashed lines) and the color areas represents the percentiles, solid lines represents the median values.
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9, 7))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 3, height_ratios=[1, 1.5]) # 2 rows, 3 columns

# Row 1
ax_r = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_Amat = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1], sharey=ax_r)
ax_sigma = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2], sharey=ax_r)

# Row 2 (Indices 1 for row, and 0 to 2 for columns)
ax_Abun = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2]) # The colon ':' means "span all columns"

ax_hist = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2], sharey=ax_Abun) # The colon ':' means "span all columns"


ax_r.set_title("a)", loc='left')
ax_Amat.set_title("b)", loc='left', fontsize='medium')
ax_sigma.set_title("c)", loc='left', fontsize='medium')
ax_Abun.set_title("d)", loc='left', fontsize='medium')
ax_hist.set_title("e)", loc='left', fontsize='medium')


ax_r.barh(species_ids, r)
ax_r.set(
    ylabel=r"Species $i$",
    xlabel=r"Growth rate $r_i$"
)


ax_sigma.barh(species_ids, sigmas)
ax_sigma.set(
    ylabel=r"Species $i$",
    xlabel=r"Noise intensity $\sigma_i$"
)


plot_matrix_A(Amat, species_ids, ax=ax_Amat)
plot_percentiles_time(traj_stoch, species_ids, qs = [5, 25, 50, 75, 95], ax=ax_Abun)
# ax_Abun.legend(title=r"Species $i$")

Abun_stat = - np.matmul(
    np.linalg.inv(Amat),
    r
)

tmp_abun = np.linspace(traj_stoch.min(), traj_stoch.max(), 100)

for idx in species_ids:
    ax_hist.hist(
        traj_stoch[:, -20, idx],
        histtype='step', orientation='horizontal',
        density=True, linewidth=2, bins=40,
        color=traj_colors[idx], label=f"{idx}"
    )
    # ax_hist.axhline(
    #     Abun_stat[idx],
    #     color=traj_colors[idx]
    # )
    ax_hist.plot(
        stats.norm.pdf(tmp_abun, Abun_stat[idx], sigmas[idx]),
        tmp_abun,
        color=traj_colors[idx]
    )
# ax_hist.set_xscale("log")
# ax_hist.set_xlim(1e-3, 10)
# ax_hist.axvline(Abun_stat)
ax_hist.set(
    xlabel="Density"
)
ax_Abun.legend(
    title=r"Species $i$", 
    frameon=False,
    # loc="lower right"
    )
# fig.legend(loc='outside upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
```
